# shash.builds

> shash.builds is Shashwat Jain's public build-in-public repo: free Claude skills and open-source web tools for US service businesses and web designers. Shashwat is a web designer in India who works US hours (8:30 am to 6:30 pm ET) and builds one-page websites for US service businesses: $400 flat, live in 7 days.

Code is MIT. Content in content/ and media/ is CC BY 4.0.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/README.md): what's here, quick start, how to hire Shashwat
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable list of every skill and tool
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should find, install and contribute to things here
- [STATUS.md](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/STATUS.md): public build log, backlog of upcoming drops
